metadata.description: Small, sharp document tools for Claude Code. Each plugin draws the line in the same place: deterministic work goes in a dependency-free Node script, judgement stays in the skill, and nothing is reported as done until a verifier proves the text survived. **md-in-pdf2md** recovers the original Markdown from a PDF that was printed from Markdown — dual-mode pdftotext extraction exposes every line-wrap junction, the skill resolves each as a language judgement (CJK breaks anywhere, so `가맹본`+`부` joins but `동시에`+`서울` does not), and a character-level gate proves nothing was lost. **mdbrown** renders Markdown into one self-contained HTML report — all CSS inlined, zero external requests, light/dark aware, CJK-tuned typography, sticky section index, separate print stylesheet. Both scripts also run standalone with plain `node`, no install. Install: `/plugin marketplace add SoliEstre/EstreTools` then `/plugin install md-in-pdf2md@estretools`.

plugins.name: md-in-pdf2md
plugins.description: PDF → Markdown, for PDFs that were Markdown to begin with. Rebuilds tables, lists and links the PDF flattened, resolves every line-wrap junction as a language judgement instead of a blind join, and gates the result with a character-level fidelity check.

plugins.name: mdbrown
plugins.description: Markdown → one self-contained HTML report. Every style inlined, no CDN or fonts fetched, light/dark aware, CJK-tuned typography, responsive tables, sticky section index, and a print stylesheet that renders back to a clean PDF. Deterministic, so a document set stays visually consistent.
